title: Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXVIII OF 2018
ACT XXVIII OF 2018
SINDH DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF INFRASTRUCTURE
CESS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure
Cess Act, 2017
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-34/2018,
dated 22.5.2018.---The Sindh
Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess (Amendment) Bill, 2017
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 30th April, 2018 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 12th May, 2018 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess Act, 2017, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Development and Maintenance of Infrastructure Cess
(Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
